scripts.dev: npm run dev:client & npm run dev:server & npm run dev:shared
scripts.fresh: npm run clean && npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project packages/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project packages/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check:quality: npm run check:unused && npm run check:duplicates && npm run check:deps
scripts.check:exports-manual: npm run check:exports-manual:shared && npm run check:exports-manual:server && npm run check:exports-manual:client
scripts.check:exports-manual:shared:
echo '
📦 Checking shared package exports...' && cd packages/shared && ts-prune --error
scripts.check:exports-manual:server:
echo '
📦 Checking server package exports (excluding index.ts public API)...' && cd packages/server && ts-prune --ignore 'src/index.ts' --error || true
scripts.check:exports-manual:client:
echo '
📦 Checking client package exports (Next.js pages are intentionally exported)...' && cd packages/client && ts-prune --ignore 'src/pages' --error || true
scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:quality
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd packages/server && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/server && npx prisma db seed
